title: Orbital Mechanics
description: An orbit is falling round the world and always missing it. Speed and height are tied together by one equation, vis-viva, and moving between orbits takes two burns: one to stretch the orbit out, one to round it off at the top. Unlocks Station Modules, the Crew Capsule and the Orbital Station.

puzzle.goal: A body moves round a planet of mass M on an orbit whose semi-major axis is a. At distance r from the planet's centre, its kinetic and potential energy add up to a constant that depends only on a: the vis-viva equation. Write v, its speed there.
puzzle.name: Vis-viva
puzzle.ask: Find v in m/s for a craft r = @{r} m from the Earth's centre on an orbit with a = @{a} m (G = @{G}, M = @{M} kg).
puzzle.method: Energy per mass: ½v² − GM/r = −GM/(2a), the same anywhere on the orbit.
